Hence the phase-1 obligation is exactly **INC-MONO** (a recreate draws a strictly greater incarnation for that path); if a drop+recreate could occur within one build without advancing `build_sequence`, use the dedicated sticky per-`server_root` incarnation allocator (the spec's fallback).
